The '''Echani double-brand''' was a [[vibro double-blade]] used by the [[Echani/Legends|Echani]]. It possessed a rare [[Cortosis-weave|cortosis weave]], allowing it to be fairly resistant to [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] attacks. This made it one the most deadly Echani weapons ever created.

==Behind the scenes==
The Echani double-brand was intended to appear in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' but it was removed from the final version of the game. As the weapon was still present in the game files, it could be obtained using cheat codes.
